pois.name: Jardí Botànic de Barcelona
pois.openingHours: Nov-Mar: 10:00-18:00; Apr-May,Sep-Oct: 10:00-19:00; Jun-Aug: 10:00-20:00; Dec 25,Jan 01,May 01,Jun 24 off; PH off
pois.intro: The Botanical Garden of Barcelona is a botanical garden in the Montjuïc hill of Barcelona set amongst a number of stadiums used in the Summer Olympic Games of 1992. Although a botanical garden had been established in Barcelona as early as 1888, the current gardens date from 1999.

pois.name: Can Ramonet
pois.intro: El Restaurant Can Ramonet és un establiment de la Barceloneta inclòs en l'Inventari del Patrimoni Arquitectònic Català.

pois.name: Can Culleretes
pois.intro: Can Culleretes és un restaurant situat al carrer d'en Quintana, 5 de Barcelona, catalogat com a establiment d'interès.

pois.name: Basílica de la Sagrada Família
pois.intro: Basílica i Temple Expiatori de la Sagrada Família, or simply Sagrada Família, is a Catholic church in the Eixample district of Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. Designed by the Catalan architect Antoni Gaudí, it is the tallest church in the world.

pois.name: Spotify Camp Nou
pois.intro: Camp Nou, officially Spotify Camp Nou for sponsorship reasons, and often referred to in English as the Nou Camp, is a stadium in Barcelona and the home of La Liga club FC Barcelona since its opening in 1957.

pois.name: Parc Güell
pois.intro: Park Güell is a complex of parks and gardens in Barcelona with architectural elements, located in the La Salut neighborhood of the Gràcia district in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. It is situated on the southern slope of the Turó del Carmel hill, part of the Collserola mountain range, overlooking the city.

pois.name: Casa Batlló
pois.intro: Casa Batlló is a building in the center of Barcelona, Spain. It was designed by Antoni Gaudí, and is considered one of his masterpieces.

pois.name: Casa Milà
pois.intro: Casa Milà, popularly known as La Pedrera in reference to its unconventional rough-hewn appearance, is a Modernista building in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. It was the last private residence designed by architect Antoni Gaudí and was built between 1906 and 1912.

pois.name: Palau de la Música Catalana
pois.address: 4-6 Carrer del Palau de la Música, Barcelona
pois.intro: Palau de la Música Catalana is a concert hall in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. Designed in the Catalan modernista style by the architect Lluís Domènech i Montaner, it was built between 1905 and 1908 for Orfeó Català, a choral society founded in 1891 that was a leading force in the Catalan cultural movement that came to be known as the Renaixença.

pois.name: Catedral de la Santa Creu i Santa Eulàlia
pois.intro: The Cathedral of the Holy Cross and Saint Eulalia, also known as Barcelona Cathedral, is the seat of the archbishop of Barcelona in Catalonia, Spain. The cathedral was constructed from the thirteenth to fifteenth centuries, with the principal work done in the fourteenth century.

pois.name: Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys
pois.intro: Lluís Companys Olympic Stadium, also known as Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys, formerly known as the Estadi de Montjuïc and Estadi Olímpic de Montjuïc and also known in English as the Barcelona Olympic Stadium, is a stadium in Barcelona, Catalonia.

pois.name: La Rambla
pois.intro: La Rambla is considered the most well known street in central Barcelona. A tree-lined pedestrian street, it stretches for 1.2 kilometres connecting the Plaça de Catalunya in its center with the Christopher Columbus Monument at Port Vell.

pois.name: Sant Pau Recinte Modernista
pois.address: 167 Carrer de Sant Antoni Maria Claret, 08025
pois.openingHours: PH,Su 10:00-14:30; Nov-Mar: Mo-Sa 10:00-16:30; Apr-Oct: Mo-Sa 10:00-18:30; Jan 01,Jan 06,Dec 25: off
pois.wikipedia: ca:Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau
pois.intro: The former Hospital de la Santa Creu i Sant Pau in the neighborhood of El Guinardó, Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain, is a complex built between 1901 and 1930. It is one of the most prominent works of the Catalan modernisme architect Lluís Domènech i Montaner.

pois.name: Plaça de Catalunya
pois.intro: Plaça de Catalunya is a large square in central Barcelona that is generally considered to be both its city centre and the place where the old city and the 19th century-built Eixample meet.

pois.name: Casa Vicens
pois.intro: Casa Vicens is a modernist building situated in the Gràcia neighbourhood of Barcelona. It is the work of architect Antoni Gaudí and is considered to be his first major project.

pois.name: Palau Güell
pois.intro: The Palau Güell is a mansion designed by the architect Antoni Gaudí for the industrial tycoon Eusebi Güell, and was built between 1886 and 1888. It is situated on the Carrer Nou de la Rambla, in the El Raval neighborhood of Barcelona in Catalonia, Spain.

pois.name: Museu Nacional d'Art de Catalunya
pois.intro: The Museu Nacional d'Art de Catalunya, abbreviated as MNAC, is a museum of Catalan visual art located in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain.

pois.name: el Tibidabo
pois.intro: Tibidabo is a hill overlooking Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. At 512 metres, it is the tallest hill in the Serra de Collserola.

pois.name: Museu Picasso
pois.openingHours: Jan 1, May 1, Jun 24, Dec 25 off; Tu, We, Su 09:00-20:00; Th-Sa 09:00-21:00
pois.intro: The Museu Picasso is an art museum in Barcelona, in Catalonia, Spain. It houses an extensive collection of artworks by the twentieth-century Spanish artist Pablo Picasso, with a total of 4251 of his works.

pois.name: Museu d'Història de Barcelona
pois.intro: The Museum of the History of Barcelona is a history museum that conserves, researches, communicates and exhibits the historical heritage of the city of Barcelona, from its origins in Roman times until the present day. The museum's headquarters are located on Plaça del Rei, in the Barcelona Gothic Quarter.

pois.name: Pavelló Mies van der Rohe
pois.address: 7 Avinguda de Francesc Ferrer i Guàrdia, Barcelona, 08038
pois.intro: The Barcelona Pavilion is a structure designed by Ludwig Mies van der Rohe and Lilly Reich. It was originally built as the German Pavilion for the 1929 International Exposition in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain.

pois.name: Museu d'Art Contemporani de Barcelona
pois.intro: The Barcelona Museum of Contemporary Art is a contemporary art museum situated in the Plaça dels Àngels, in El Raval neighborhood, Ciutat Vella district, in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. The museum opened to the public on 28 November 1995.

pois.name: l'Aquàrium de Barcelona
pois.intro: Aquarium Barcelona is an aquarium located in Port Vell, a harbor in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. The 35 aquariums at the facility are home to 11,000 animals representing 451 species.

pois.name: Camp Nou Experience
pois.intro: The FC Barcelona museum was inaugurated on 24 September 1984 under the presidency of Josep Lluís Nuñez. In 2000, the museum was renamed President Nuñez museum under the presidency of his successor, Joan Gaspart.

pois.name: Parc Zoològic de Barcelona
pois.intro: Barcelona Zoo is a zoo in the Parc de la Ciutadella in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. The zoo used to be internationally known as the home of Snowflake, the only known albino gorilla, who died in 2003.

pois.name: Museu Marítim de Barcelona
pois.intro: The Maritime Museum of Barcelona is located in the building of Drassanes Reials de Barcelona, the royal arsenal of Barcelona, dedicated to shipbuilding between the thirteenth century and eighteenth century. The first mention of these arsenals date from 1243 in a document indicating the boundaries of the city of Barcelona where it mentions its shipyard.

pois.name: Poble Espanyol de Barcelona
pois.intro: The Poble Espanyol is an open-air architectural museum in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain, approximately 400 metres away from the Fountains of Montjuïc. It is listed as a Cultural Asset of Local Interest.

pois.name: Castell de Montjuïc
pois.intro: Montjuïc Castle is an old military fortress, with roots dating back from 1640, built on top of Montjuïc hill in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. It currently serves as a Barcelona municipal facility.

pois.name: 4Gats
pois.intro: Els Quatre Gats is a café in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain, that famously became a popular meeting place for renowned artists throughout the modernist period in Catalonia, known as Modernisme.

pois.name: Museu de la Xocolata
pois.intro: Museu de la Xocolata or Museo del Chocolate in Spanish, is a private museum in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain, owned by the Gremio de Pastelería de Barcelona. The museum opened in 2000, at Calle Comercio 36, in El Born, Ciudad Vieja, on the ground level of an old barrack.

pois.name: Casa Leopoldo
pois.intro: Casa Leopoldo ist ein Traditionslokal in der Altstadt von Barcelona. Es ist benannt nach seinem Gründer Leopoldo Gil, der das Restaurant während der Weltausstellung 1929 zusammen mit seiner Frau Elvira Gil eröffnete.

pois.name: Disfrutar
pois.intro: Disfrutar is a restaurant in Barcelona with three Michelin stars. In 2023 it was ranked second in the world by Restaurant magazine; in 2024 it was ranked first.

pois.name: 7 Portes
pois.intro: Set portes es uno de los restaurantes emblemáticos de Barcelona inaugurado en el año 1836 por el comerciante catalán Josep Cuyás. Se trata de un restaurante especializado en servir diferentes platos de la cocina catalana especializándose en servir pescados y arroces.

pois.name: CiaoCiao Restaurant
pois.description: Authentic Italian cuisine in a breathtaking ambience.

pois.name: Glaciar
pois.intro: El Bar Glaciar és un establiment situat a la plaça Reial, 3 de Barcelona, catalogat com a d'interès.

pois.name: La Cova Fumada
pois.intro: La Cova Fumada és un bar tradicional barceloní, fundat l'any 1944 o 1945 al barri de la Barceloneta. Propietat de Josep Maria i Magí Solé, és conegut per la creació de la bomba.

pois.name: Pulpería A Gudiña
pois.description: Popular seafood restaurant and spanish tapas since 1993.

pois.name: Bar del Pi
pois.address: 1 Plaça de Sant Josep Oriol, Barcelona, 08002
pois.intro: El Bar del Pi és un establiment situat a la plaça de Sant Josep Oriol, 1 de Barcelona, catalogat com a establiment d'interès.

pois.name: La Terraza del Central
pois.description: En el octavo piso de nuestro hotel, sobre las animadas calles del Barrio Gótico, La Terraza del Central te invita a disfrutar de cocina mediterránea al fresco, exquisitos cócteles y vistas impresionantes. Con un ambiente relajado, es el lugar perfecto par

pois.name: Magma Bar
pois.description: Cocktail bar with authentic food in the heart of Barcelona. We blend the art of mixology with the warmth of friendly, but top-tier service, ensuring every visit is memorable. Our menu is not your usual tapas - more elaborate and with our twist.

pois.name: London Bar
pois.intro: El London Bar és un pub situat al carrer Nou de la Rambla, 34 de Barcelona, catalogat com a establiment de gran interès.

pois.name: Mercat de Sant Josep - La Boqueria
pois.intro: The Mercat de Sant Josep de la Boqueria, usually simply referred to as La Boqueria, is a large public market in the Ciutat Vella district of Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain, and one of the city's foremost tourist landmarks, with an entrance from La Rambla, not far from the Liceu, Barcelona's opera house. The market has a very diverse selection of goods.

pois.name: Arenas de Barcelona
pois.intro: Plaza de toros de las Arenas is a converted former bullring in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. Over the years it was used music venue, hosting Carlos Santana and Paco de Lucia in 1977.

pois.name: Maremagnum
pois.intro: Maremagnum est un centre commercial près du port de Barcelone, inauguré en 1995.

pois.name: Llibreria Ona
pois.description: Librería referente de la cultura catalana con una amplia selección de narrativa, poesía, ensayo, arte y música, además de actividades culturales.
pois.intro: Ona Llibres is een boekwinkel in Barcelona gespecialiseerd in Catalaanstalige literatuur. Sinds 2022 is de leiding in handen van schrijfster en uitgeefster Iolanda Batallé.

pois.name: Mercat de Santa Caterina
pois.intro: Le Marché de Santa Caterina est un marché couvert de Barcelone. Bâti en 1844 et restructuré en 2005 sur un ancien couvent, qui lui a donné son nom, il est le marché couvert le plus ancien de la ville.

pois.name: Mercat de Sant Antoni
pois.address: 56 B Carrer del Comte Borrell, Barcelona
pois.intro: Le Marché de Sant Antoni, est un des marchés les plus grands et importants de Barcelone. Il est situé dans le quartier Sant Antoni, qui lui a donné son nom.

pois.name: Librería Cómplices
pois.intro: Cómplices fue una librería especializada en temas LGBT, abierta en 1994 en Barcelona, siendo la primera de su tipo en dicha ciudad y la segunda en España después de Berkana.​

pois.name: Mercat de Sants
pois.intro: Le marché de Sants est un marché du quartier de Sants, à Barcelone. Il a été projeté par l'architecte Pere Falqués et sa construction a commencé en 1898, étant inauguré en 1913.

pois.name: Llibreria Documenta
pois.description: Librería especializada en literatura, arte y ciencias humanas, con una selección de narrativa, poesía, ensayo, historia, antropología, filosofía y libro gráfico.
pois.intro: La Llibreria Documenta es troba al carrer de Pau Claris, 144 de Barcelona. Organitza anualment el Premi Documenta de Narrativa.

pois.name: El Triangle
pois.intro: El Triangle es un centro comercial ubicado en la plaza de Cataluña de Barcelona, España.

pois.name: Llibreria Aldarull
pois.address: 72 Carrer del Torrent de l'Olla, Barcelona, 08012
pois.description: Llibreria anarquista autogestionada des de l’any 2009, centrada en la difusió de material de transformació social i agitació. Promou l’esperit crític a través de llibres, fanzins, contes, còmics, xerrades i formacions.
pois.intro: La Llibreria Aldarull és una llibreria anarquista de la Vila de Gràcia. Fundat el 26 de maig del 2009, és un projecte autogestionat per un col·lectiu d'una quinzena de persones d'ideologia llibertària.

pois.name: Parc de la Ciutadella
pois.intro: The Parc de la Ciutadella is a park on the northeastern edge of Ciutat Vella, Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. For decades following its creation in the mid-19th century, this park was the city's only green space.

pois.name: Montjuïc
pois.intro: Montjuïc is a hill in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. Montjuïc or Montjuich, meaning "Jewish Mountain" in medieval Latin and Catalan, is a broad, shallow hill in Barcelona with a rich history.

pois.name: Platja de Sant Sebastià
pois.intro: Sant Sebastià beach is located in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. At 1,100 meters, it is the longest in Barcelona.

pois.name: Font Màgica de Montjuïc
pois.intro: The Magic Fountain of Montjuïc is a fountain located at the head of Avinguda Maria Cristina in the Montjuïc neighborhood of Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. The fountain is situated below the Palau Nacional on the Montjuïc mountain and near the Plaça d'Espanya and Poble Espanyol de Barcelona.

pois.name: Jardins de Mossèn Costa i Llobera
pois.intro: Mossèn Costa i Llobera Gardens is a botanical garden in the center of Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. It is situated at the foot of Montjuïc facing the sea.

pois.name: Port Olímpic
pois.intro: The Port Olímpic is a marina located in Barcelona, Catalonia, east of the Port of Barcelona. The venue was opened in 1991.

pois.name: Parc de Joan Miró
pois.intro: The Parc de Joan Miró is a park located in the Eixample of Barcelona, near the Plaça d'Espanya, from which it is separated by the Les Arenes bullring. The name of the park is in recognition of the surrealist painter Joan Miró.

pois.name: Parc de l'Espanya Industrial
pois.intro: El parque de la España Industrial está situado entre los barrios de Sants y de Hostafrancs, en el distrito de Sants-Montjuïc de la ciudad de Barcelona, junto a la estación de ferrocarril de Barcelona-Sants.

pois.name: Font de Canaletes
pois.intro: Font de Canaletes is an ornate fountain, crowned by a lamp post, in Barcelona, Catalonia, in Rambla de Canaletes, the upper part of La Rambla, near Plaça de Catalunya. It is a fixture of football fans after Barça football matches since the 1930s.

pois.name: Rent a Bike BCN - Shop Rambla
pois.address: 1 Carrer de l'Arc de Santa Eulàlia, Barcelona, 08002
pois.description: Сеть прокатов велосипедов и камер хранения в Барселоне.

pois.name: Farmacia Madroñal
pois.intro: La Farmàcia Madroñal, abans Sabatés, és un establiment modernista situat al carrer del Comte Borrell, 133 de Barcelona, catalogat com a de gran interès.

pois.name: Basílica de Santa Maria del Mar
pois.intro: Santa Maria del Mar is a church in the Ribera district of Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain, built between 1329 and 1383 at the height of Principality of Catalonia's maritime and mercantile preeminence. It is an outstanding example of Catalan Gothic, with a purity and unity of style that is very unusual in large medieval buildings.

pois.name: Monument a Colom
pois.intro: The Columbus Monument is a 60 m tall monument to Christopher Columbus at the lower end of La Rambla, Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. It was constructed for the Exposición Universal de Barcelona in honor of Columbus' first voyage to the Americas.

pois.name: Museu de les Arts Escèniques
pois.description: El MAE, Centre de documentació i Museu de les Arts Escèniques, és el centre de referència d’informació i recerca de les arts escèniques catalanes i aplega dins seu una biblioteca, un arxiu i un museu.
pois.wikipedia: ca:Centre de Documentació i Museu de les Arts Escèniques
pois.intro: The Centre de Documentació i Museu de les Arts Escèniques, also known as MAE, is a centre for information and research on the performing arts in Catalonia, Spain. The centre has an extensive library, an archive and collections from the Institut del Teatre, which specializes in theatre, dance, opera, zarzuela, music hall, magic and circus performances.

pois.name: Temple d'August
pois.intro: The Temple of Augustus in Barcelona was a Roman temple built during the Imperial period in the colony of Barcino. The temple was the central building on Tàber Hill, currently in Carrer del Paradís number 10, in the city's so-called Gothic Quarter.

pois.name: Gran Teatre del Liceu
pois.intro: The Gran Teatre del Liceu, or simply Liceu, is a theater in Barcelona, Spain. Situated on La Rambla, it is the city's oldest theater building still in use for its original purpose.

pois.name: Platja de la Barceloneta
pois.intro: La plage de la Barceloneta est la plus ancienne et la plus célèbre des plages de Barcelone.

pois.name: Parc de l'Estació del Nord
pois.intro: El parque de la Estación del Norte se encuentra en los terrenos aledaños a la estación de autobuses del mismo nombre, en el Distrito del Ensanche de Barcelona. Fue creado en 1988 con un proyecto de Andreu Arriola, Carme Fiol y Enric Pericas.

pois.name: Jardins de Laribal
pois.intro: Les jardins de Laribal se trouvent sur la montagne de Montjuïc, dans le district de Sants-Montjuic, à Barcelone. Ils ont été réalisés entre 1917 et 1924, dans l'optique de l'Exposition Internationale de Barcelone de 1929.

terminalResolution.notes: All the Adossat and World Trade Center cruise terminals are correct; kept them all so distances use the nearest. Moved terminals B, C, D, E and H onto their Google Maps locations along the Moll Adossat (the old pins ran out into the harbour, up to 1.4 km off) and added the World Trade Center terminal. Terminal A's pin is unchanged; Google has no separate listing for it.
